predecessors.name: Post-Angkor Cambodia
predecessors.text: Hà Tiên, Phú Quốc and the Gulf of Siam coast to Lũng Kỳ (Kep): the Mạc clan's settlements

successors.name: Nguyễn dynasty (Đại Nam)
successors.text: Hà Tiên, Phú Quốc and the Gulf of Siam coast to Lũng Kỳ (Kep): the Mạc clan's settlements

ledger.x: 1707: Mạc Cửu turns Hà Tiên to the Nguyễn.

wars.name: Cambodian-Siamese invasion of Hà Tiên (1715)
wars.outcome: Thommo Reachea III of Cambodia, with Siamese support, defeats Mạc Cửu, who flees to Lũng Kỳ (Kep); the page does not say how Hà Tiên was recovered.

wars.name: Cambodian invasion of Hà Tiên (1739)
wars.outcome: A Cambodian army led by 'Nặc Bồn' invades Hà Tiên and is 'utterly defeated' by Mạc Thiên Tứ; no change of border.

wars.name: Siamese conquest of Hà Tiên (1771)
wars.outcome: Taksin captures Hà Tiên in 1771; Mạc Thiên Tứ returns with Nguyễn help in 1773.

certainty.note: A port principality: the pages name towns and villages, never a frontier.
